mechanism: Tolterodine inhibits CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, potentially increasing glyburide metabolism and affecting glucose control; additive hypoglycemic risk with anticholinergic effects masking hypoglycemia symptoms.
action: Monitor blood glucose closely during tolterodine initiation or dose changes; counsel patients on hypoglycemia awareness as anticholinergic effects may reduce sweating and other warning signs.
